metrics.pv: Unique event IDs with event_type=page_view, per source/app/business date
metrics.uv: Distinct non-null app-scoped anonymous_id across accepted activity events, per source/app/business date. Never sum as period uniques.
metrics.requests: First accepted trusted request_complete per source/app/request_id. Covers generation completions, not all incoming HTTP requests.
metrics.successes: Count of those request completions with success=true
metrics.character_popularity: Unique character_select events, not message count
metrics.conversion: click -> arrival -> observed request -> trusted success within 30m inclusive; latest valid click, once per click without fallback. Character selection is optional diagnostic activity.
metrics.sessions: New session at >=30m inactivity per source/app/anonymous_id; whole session assigned to HK start date, including cross-midnight events. Closed only after 30m silence at cutoff.
metrics.retained_d1_d7: Cohort is first observed HK date in the complete frozen input history. Eligible only once the D1/D7 HK observation day ends; retained is null before maturity. Daily rates use their eligible cohort denominator.

dimensions.content: SCD2 [valid_from,valid_to); tombstones close historical membership; current regrouping is a separate lookup

quality: integer metrics equal at a shared accepted_at cutoff
